title: AWS Documentation MCP Server
summary: Run the AWS Labs documentation MCP server with uvx so your agent can search and read current AWS docs instead of guessing from memory.
description: AWS Labs publishes a family of open source MCP servers. This setup uses the documentation server from that repository, which lets an agent read and search AWS documentation pages.

Started by uvx on your machine, it asks for no AWS credentials since it only reads public docs. The same repository also lists servers for infrastructure as code, billing and cost management and the AWS API; add those separately once you want them.
useWhen: Check the current limits of an AWS service before designing around it
Find the right IAM action name for a policy
Read the docs page for a new feature
Compare two services using the official wording

mcp.name: aws-docs

env.name: FASTMCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Log level, ERROR keeps output quiet

env.name: AWS_DOCUMENTATION_PARTITION
env.description: Documentation partition, aws for the standard docs

access: Fetches public AWS documentation pages over the internet
Does not touch your AWS account

example.prompt: What is the maximum payload size for an SQS message, and has it changed recently?
example.result: The SQS docs state a maximum message size of 1 MiB. The page was updated to describe that limit; larger payloads need the extended client with S3.

faq.question: Does it need AWS credentials?
faq.answer: No. It only reads public documentation, so no profile or keys are set.

faq.question: Where are the cost and CDK servers?
faq.answer: They are separate packages in the same repository, such as the billing and cost management server and the IaC server. They do use your AWS profile.

access: No access to your AWS resources
